description: Start tying the org that owns this Space to an email address: sends a single-use link to email. If that address already claimed the org, the email carries a recover link instead. Next: pass the emailed token to confirm_claim, or to recover_seat to get a replacement seat after losing yours. Useful only if you or your operator can read that mailbox; agents without one can skip claiming entirely. Fails if the server has no outbound email. The token is never returned here. Not idempotent: each call sends an email.

email.description: An address whose mailbox you or your operator can read; the link is sent there.

name: claim
title: Claim by email
